methods.orientation: every pair is [A, B] in card order (cards_upcoming.json order when that file exists, else Wikipedia order); p_* = probability that A wins; P(B) = 1 - P(A)
methods.p_shin: Shin (1993) model, z (insider share) solved so the probabilities sum to 1; p_i = (sqrt(z^2 + 4(1-z) q_i^2 / S) - z) / (2(1-z)), q_i = 1/d_i, S = sum q_i
methods.p_power: power method p_i = q_i^k, k solved so the probabilities sum to 1 (best on the 2019-2023 tune period in tools/market.py)
methods.p_consensus: headline: logit-mean of the per-book Shin no-vig P(A) over unique sportsbooks (exchanges excluded; min and max trimmed when 5+ books)
methods.p_meandec_mult: mean of the books' decimal odds per side, then multiplicative devig: the same estimator as the historical close in data/derived/market.json (comparable benchmark)
methods.p_sharp_shin: logit-mean of Shin no-vig over the sharp/low-margin books present (Pinnacle, Circa, Bookmaker, BetOnline, Bet105)
methods.p_exchange_mult: logit-mean of multiplicative no-vig over exchanges / prediction markets (Polymarket, Kalshi, SXBet, ProphetX, 4casters, 4Cx)
methods.one_line_per_book: a book seen on several sites counts once; preferred source order fightodds > bestfightodds > actionnetwork > covers; other copies are kept in other_source_lines
methods.sanity: a line is rejected when its overround is outside [-0.01, 0.15] (0.2 for exchanges) or, with 4+ books, its no-vig logit is more than 0.6 from the cross-book median; rejected lines are kept in rejected_lines
methods.open: market open: logit-mean of Shin no-vig over fightodds.io per-book opening lines (sportsbooks only; exchange openers are illiquid placeholders and are ignored); plus Action Network's opener
methods.props: bestfightodds props: two_way = median over books of Shin no-vig P(yes) when both sides are offered; method = per-book Shin devig of the 6-way (7 with draw) method market [ko_A, sub_A, dec_A, ko_B, sub_B, dec_B], median across books, renormalised
methods.phase: pre_start when the snapshot was taken before the bout's start (Action Network schedule, else a conservative early estimate per region); post_start lines are the books' archived closing lines (or in-play) and are never used as a pre-fight forecast

meta.use: forward-test benchmark only: these lines are known before the fight, so they may be compared with or blended into a forecast committed at the same time; never a training feature for 2026 fights (hidden-data protocol, docs/BACKLOG.md)
